name: gushwork-design
description: Gushwork's governed design system. Six surface-scoped skills — marketing web, product dashboard, reports, hub tools, lead-magnet documents, and slide decks — plus a catch-all brand skill for everything else that carries the Gushwork name, over one shared foundation of tokens, voice, and shared atoms, generated from the Gush Design System v2.0 and GW-Slides Figma files.
